prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET: black titanium official X on a mint rounded-square app tile, with a curved protective field and sage-gray exterior.
Change ONLY the position and extent of the protective field and its partial luminous rim. Keep the X geometry, position, size and black titanium finish exactly unchanged. Keep the tile's rounded corners and the white presentation canvas.

CRITICAL SPATIAL REQUIREMENT:
The X has four terminals. Its TOP-LEFT terminal, BOTTOM-LEFT terminal, and BOTTOM-RIGHT terminal must ALL be fully INSIDE the pale mint protected area, with visible pale mint space beyond each terminal.
ONLY the TOP-RIGHT terminal must protrude OUTSIDE the protective field into the cooler sage-gray exterior. The circular boundary should cross the thin ascending upper-right arm near its tip, leaving approximately its final 15–20% outside. The X remains continuous and intact across this boundary; the ring passes BEHIND the X, never cuts off or hides the metal.

Geometry guidance relative to the rounded-square tile, not the full white canvas: center the implied near-circular field at roughly 43% tile width and 56% tile height, with radius roughly 43% of tile width. This shifts the protective region toward the lower-left and gives its three sheltered terminals breathing room. The far upper-right tip lies beyond the curved boundary. Prioritize this three-inside / one-outside relationship over matching the old arc location.

Color and material:
INSIDE: original luminous pale mint #EAF6EF.
OUTSIDE but within the tile: visibly different cooler, muted sage-gray #C4D5CE.
Separate the two colors along the protective field's curved boundary, with a subtle glass refraction transition. Preserve the light overall appearance.
Only a short upper-right section of the boundary catches a thin tapered pearl-mint reflection. Elsewhere it is softly blended, but the three protected terminals must clearly sit within the pale mint color field. No complete outlined ring. Keep the rim subtle and behind X.

Avoid: leaving any of the other three terminals outside, centering the field toward upper-right, fitting the ring around all four terminals, altering or shrinking X, giant flare, extra shield symbol, stars, extra objects, text, neon, thick ring strokes. Same single-icon composition and framing.
user_direction: 除右上端点外，X 的另外三个端点均应处于保护圈内。
note: 保护区域向左下调整；左上、左下、右下三个端点位于浅绿罩内，右上端点伸出到灰绿罩外。
rejection_reason: 用户取消保护圈，恢复浅绿纯色底与黑钛 X。
